verdict.rationale: AI inbox triage is a fair axis for an email provider, but nothing in the evidence shows Fastmail auto-labeling, categorizing, or surfacing mail with AI that the user can steer and audit. User-defined Filters & Rules and spam filtering are adjacent features, not AI triage. The JMAP API and push are developer building blocks someone could use to build a triage tool, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, AI triages my inbox for me — auto-labeling, categorizing, and surfacing what needs attention — with behavior I can steer and audit
